name: Consultant engagements
summary: A pipeline for an independent consultant: engagements from introduction to won with an acceptance check before the offer, a follow-up date agreed on the proposal call, and deliverables that gate delivery and closeout.
description: Run a consulting practice in one place: engagements through discovery, scoping, proposal and decision, the date of the follow-up agreed with the sponsor, an acceptance check (capacity, independence, confidentiality) before the offer, deliverables with their due and acceptance dates, and a closeout that asks for feedback and a testimonial. It stores the pipeline, the relationships and the delivery gates. It is not time tracking, invoicing, proposal e-signature or resource planning, and it holds no confidential client data.
